overview_description.description:
Problem: U.S. retailers lose $120B annually to theft, a figure that has doubled since 2020. Existing solutions are outdated, hardware-heavy, and ineffective.
Solution: Lexius plugs directly into existing cameras — no new hardware — to detect and prevent shoplifting in real time using AI.

about_short_description.short_description: Lexius develops software that uses camera feeds to identify potential shoplifting and notify staff in real time.

product.name: Live Shoplifting Detection
product.description: Real-time detection of shoplifting incidents, providing immediate alerts for proactive intervention.

product.name: Shoplifting Notifications
product.description: Instant notifications sent to your phone, tablet, or desktop upon detection of suspicious behavior.

product.name: Multi-Camera Monitoring
product.description: Simultaneous oversight of multiple camera feeds, reducing the need for manual surveillance.

product.name: Review Clips
product.description: Quick assessment of potential shoplifting incidents through concise video clips, streamlining decision-making.

product.name: Plug and Play Integration
product.description: Integration with existing camera systems without additional hardware, enabling quick setup and use.
